_comment: What the system may do without asking. Copy to permissions.json. Enforced in code, not just documented — change a value and it takes effect immediately, no restart.

_levels.ask: must request permission each time and get an explicit yes
_levels.never: refused outright, even if asked mid-task (change this file instead)

read_subjects._note: Sender, subject, date, labels. Safe — no message content.

read_bodies._note: Full message content. Must request and get a yes each time.

search._note: Querying the mailbox returns subjects/metadata only.

draft._note: Creating a draft is safe — drafts do not send. You review before anything leaves.

send._note: NEVER automatic. Requires explicit confirmation of the final text AND the sending account. Enforced in code: send takes a draft id only and --yes must restate the account.

reply._note: Same as send — a reply is an outbound message.

modify_labels._note: Labeling/archiving changes your mailbox state. Reversible, but still your call.

delete._note: Never delete email. Not recoverable enough to risk.

create_event._note: Invites notify other people — same weight as sending email.

delete._note: Verify pushed state and untracked files first — git diff misses untracked.

push._note: Also bounded per-project by config/projects.json (auto-merge / auto-pr / review-required).

publish_public_content._note: Social posts, uploads, anything visible to others.
